target_buyers.organization: City of Ashtabula - Planning & Community Development
target_buyers.why_target: City zoning department responsible for zoning permits, building reviews, and code enforcement. Issues zoning permits for pools, sheds, decks, garages, and new businesses. Digital zoning assistance would streamline permit applications and citizen inquiries.

contacts.name: Planning & Community Development Department
contacts.title: Zoning Permits & Code Enforcement
contacts.notes: Primary contact for zoning permits in City of Ashtabula. Office located at 4717 Main Ave, Ashtabula, OH. Fax: 440-992-7180. Review process typically takes up to one week.

target_buyers.why_target: County planning department overseeing subdivision approvals, zoning amendments for townships, and major development reviews. Serves unincorporated areas of Ashtabula County and coordinates with township zoning boards.

contacts.name: Jake Brand
contacts.title: Director, Planning & Development
contacts.notes: Department Director. Office located at 25 West Jefferson Street, Old Courthouse 1st Floor, Jefferson, OH 44047. Fax: 440-576-2758. Hours: M-F 8:00am-4:30pm.
